Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving home on a weekday afternoon in League City, Texas, moving slowly through a light drizzle, when the
car in front of me stopped short and I could not avoid a low-speed head-on collision with the vehicle coming the other
way. The impact was not severe, but my head struck the side window and the steering wheel, and I felt dizzy and
nauseated within minutes. I was taken to a local clinic, where I was diagnosed with a concussion and advised to rest.
I have given this same account to the adjuster, to the officer at the scene, and to my doctor, and I have not changed
any detail. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim so the repairs and medical costs can
be reviewed. I can provide the medical notes and photographs of the vehicles on request.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
